program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: target-conditional marginal-learning-value attribution
question: After R40 showed that a fixed training-support envelope does not identify a lower-sign-error applicability region, is residual marginal-learning-value error caused by using one global calibration response across different budget target domains?
hypothesis: R40 falsified the fixed support-envelope explanation: IN_ENVELOPE covered 19/33 excluded cases but had sign error 0.578947 versus 0.515152 globally, while OUT_OF_ENVELOPE sign error was lower at 0.428571. Freeze a bounded target-conditional residual calibration with no new learned representation. GLOBAL_BASE6 is the byte-identical R40 raw-target ridge predictor. TARGET_DOMAIN_OFFSET keeps that predictor unchanged and learns exactly three scalar residual offsets from training allocations only, keyed by the candidate allocation's deterministic target domain: the domain with the largest positive budget delta from equal allocation (code, structured, or technical_prose; exact ties break code→structured→technical_prose). For each outer holdout, compute the global BASE6 prediction and actual allocation advantage for all 27 non-equal training allocation cases, freeze each target-domain offset as the arithmetic mean of (actual advantage - global prediction) within that target-domain stratum, then add the corresponding frozen offset to each held-out excluded case's global prediction. This tests whether the marginal value of spending the next unit of budget has a domain-specific response bias without adding new features, nonlinear capacity, or meta-learning.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: the residual BASE6 sign error is concentrated outside a fixed coordinate-wise training support envelope
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: marginal future learning value may be target-conditional: the same internal state can imply different response depending on which data domain receives the next budget increment

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R40's in-envelope region had lower MAE but worse sign error than the global baseline, so geometric support alone does not identify where allocation advantage transfers.
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: add exactly three training-only scalar residual offsets to the byte-identical global BASE6 predictor; do not change BASE6 features, global fit, target, manifests, budget, candidate allocations, ridge lambda, exclusion set, or held-out ordering
cause_effect_trace.target_domain_rule: for each non-equal allocation compute allocation minus equal allocation per domain; choose the domain with largest positive delta; exact ties break code, then structured, then technical_prose
cause_effect_trace.control_rule: GLOBAL_BASE6 is byte-identical R40/R39 raw-target predictor
cause_effect_trace.conditional_rule: TARGET_DOMAIN_OFFSET freezes one scalar mean residual per target domain from the 27 non-equal training allocation cases: mean(actual allocation advantage - GLOBAL_BASE6 predicted advantage). Each held-out case selects its target domain from allocation alone before held-out outcome and adds only that frozen scalar to GLOBAL_BASE6.
cause_effect_trace.fallback_rule: if any target-domain stratum has fewer than three training allocation cases or any offset is non-finite, mark the experiment invalid; do not borrow another stratum, tune a threshold, or add capacity
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R41 is attribution only. Support authorizes only a separately preregistered bounded target-conditional correction/replication; allocator behavior remains unchanged.

frozen_reuse.capacity: byte-identical GLOBAL_BASE6 plus exactly three scalar offsets
frozen_reuse.target_domain_training_cases: all 27 non-equal allocation cases across the three training manifests per outer holdout
frozen_reuse.target_domain_response: one arithmetic-mean residual offset per target domain; no additional ridge fit or features

classification_rules.mixed: valid AND target_conditional_sign_error_rate<global_sign_error_rate AND target_conditional_mean_absolute_error<global_mean_absolute_error but one or both supported thresholds are missed
classification_rules.negative: valid AND supported is false AND mixed is false
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, exact R30 exclusion, GLOBAL_BASE6 identity, deterministic target-domain rule, three scalar residual-offset definitions, raw target, ridge lambda, held-out ordering, minimum-stratum requirement, provenance or accounting rule fails

rsi_success_note: R41 is bounded target-conditional attribution on studied manifests; no allocation policy is changed and prospective disjoint validation remains required.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, GLOBAL_BASE6, target-domain rule/tie-break, residual-offset definition, thresholds, exclusion set, budget/capacity, held-out ordering, classification or authority after primary output.
